name: Orbital Settings (round-trip extraction)
description: Design Graph extracted from the implemented B-graph settings page (SettingsPage.xaml, SettingsPage.xaml.cs, Tokens.xaml). One screen with a page header and four section cards: Profile, About, Paths, Actions.

unresolved.question: What UI does the header search pill open when activated?
unresolved.reason: The source explicitly leaves the target unresolved: no Click handler is wired, and the code-behind comments name unresolved.header.search-target with these two candidate interpretations.

unresolved.question: Should component.info-row and component.path-field be consolidated into a single label/value component?
unresolved.reason: They share label/value colors and mono-small typography (both label halves even share OrbitalFieldLabelStyle) but differ in layout (horizontal right-aligned value vs stacked wrapping value). The source keeps them distinct and names this open question.

unresolved.question: What folder path or launch target does 'Open Data Folder' open?
unresolved.reason: The control is declared but OnOpenDataFolderClick is an intentional stub; no path or URI exists in these sources (the host app supplies the folder).

unresolved.question: What runtime data populates the info-row and path-field values (currently the '...' placeholder) and the version text?
unresolved.reason: Comments name host-app binding sources, but no bindings are implemented in this isolated page; values render the static placeholder '...'.

unresolved.question: How is the display name persisted when Save is clicked?
unresolved.reason: Comments say the value round-trips through the app's SettingsService in the real app, but persistence is explicitly out of scope for this isolated page; only the 'Saved!' flash is implemented.

metadata.notes: Node ids follow the annotations the source author left in comments; comment text was treated as declared documentation evidence.
